en.hook: Parquet Bloom Filter tuning resolves analytical query scan timeouts and reduces Amazon S3 read bytes by 68% during high-cardinality telemetry point lookups.
en.body:
Parquet Bloom Filter tuning resolves analytical query scan timeouts and reduces Amazon S3 read bytes by 68% during high-cardinality telemetry point lookups.

Operational proof is in the GitHub repository referenced in this post.
